title: Wiemer photo band
description: An edge-to-edge interior photo (2:3 on phones, nearly square or 3:2 on wide screens) that drifts gently inside its frame as you scroll. Optional white round plus buttons sit on the things in the picture; hovering turns the plus 45° and grows it, and clicking opens a small centred card with a picture, a title and a line of text.
notes: hotspot cards use the HTML popover attribute: no JavaScript, Escape or a click outside closes them
media is a slot (an , cover) slightly taller than the band; empty, it shows a soft placeholder
name: wiemer-photo-band
